real_screen.observation: All three predefined quotient maps produced high descriptive rescue, requiring prevalence conditioning before interpretation.

prevalence_matched_null.definition: Within each held-out record, preserve exact positions at which any relevant projected primitive occurs and preserve per-record projected primitive counts; permute primitive identity labels across those positions. Record boundaries, relevant-position density, k, direction and the 16..10000 bp window remain fixed.

result: At deep bacterium-archaeon-eukaryote separation, apparent quotient rescue is fully explained by projected primitive prevalence and spatial opportunity under the frozen matched relational null. RY, MK and WS all fail Stage A.
claim_ceiling: This is a negative result for the deepest cross-domain calibration only. It does not establish failure or success of the same fixed quotient maps at the four preregistered phylogenetic ladders.
anti_drift: Do not add a new partition, nonlinear encoding, change k, change the ordered window, or otherwise rescue Stage A post hoc. The next test uses the same fixed maps on the frozen EXP-0002 ladder architecture.
